component: Folder pane unread and new-message badge CSS

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Collapsed folder rows compute new-message state across descendants. The unread badge CSS adds the exact collapsed new-message descendant selector to the shared transparent outline block, then keeps new-message text and border-color in its later override. Reusing that selector preserves the structural outline and its color precedence. This is a scoped selector/state relationship, not a global rule to merge CSS blocks. No rendered or runtime result was verified.
title: Collapsed new-message badges share the unread outline while keeping their own color override
